thread:
sasha: Quick sync — we need to lock ownership and contract for the new continuous-batching signals so Console can build the dashboard and Alerts can be wired. I sketched a minimal set: batch_size_distribution, batch_wait_ms_{p50,p95}, queue_saturation_ratio, inflight_queue_len, fill_rate_pct, backpressure_count. Who owns producing/ingesting each?

jamal: I can own batch_size_distribution and batch_wait_ms metrics from runtime. Runtime currently exposes a histogram and per-model gauges. Need label guidance (model, pool, route, deploy_env).

mike: Eng-infra can own queue_saturation_ratio and inflight_queue_len as they’re computed at the pool/proxy layer. We plan to roll a Prometheus exporter in the balancer. Will it be okay to add a pool_id label?

ava: Console needs stable metric names and labels. Prefer model, pool_id, zone, and routing_policy as labels. Also request a `rollout_stage` label (canary vs stable) so we can compare. Dashboard tiles: cohorted histograms for batch_size, p50/p95 wait lines, and a saturation heatmap.

leah: For SLOs we want a derived metric: percent_requests_with_wait_lt_50ms over 5m windows. Can infra/runtime emit directly or should Console compute it?

jamal: Emitting percent is noisy on runtime. We can emit raw counts: wait_ms_bucket counters + request_total, then Console or Alerting can compute percentiles/ratios. We already have exemplar-capable histograms in the runtime.

mike: infra can emit `pool_inflight_total` and `pool_capacity` so queue_saturation_ratio = pool_inflight_total / pool_capacity. We'll add pool_capacity as a constant gauge.

ava: Perfect. Can you post the exact metric names/labels? We'll hardcode them in the dashboard ingestion until v1 contract. Also want to avoid high-cardinality labels — routing_policy ok, but no free-form request_id etc.

jamal: Proposed runtime names:  
```
redwood_runtime_batch_size_histogram{model, pool_id, route, deploy_env}
redwood_runtime_batch_wait_ms_bucket{le, model, pool_id, route, deploy_env}
redwood_runtime_requests_total{model, pool_id, route, deploy_env}
```
We can add `quantized_model_version` if needed but optional.

mike: Proposed infra names:  
```
redwood_infra_pool_inflight_total{pool_id, zone}
redwood_infra_pool_capacity{pool_id, zone}
redwood_infra_fill_rate_pct{pool_id, zone, route}
redwood_infra_backpressure_count{pool_id, zone, reason}
```
We’ll avoid adding `route` to capacity gauge to keep cardinality down.

ava: Console asks for these to be emitted to Cortex remote_write with 30s scrape and 1m aggregation window. Also please add `unit=\"ms\"` or `unit=\"pct\"` label where helpful so panels auto-format.

leah: For Alerts, we need export to Alertmanager with a 1m scrape lag guarantee. Also add debug logs when backpressure_count spikes > 5 in 1m, include pool_id and recent violators.

jamal: Runtime note: continuous batching means per-token vs per-request metrics confusion. We'll include `tokens_total` and `tokens_in_batch` summaries:  
```
redwood_runtime_tokens_total{model, pool_id}
redwood_runtime_tokens_in_batch_histogram{model, pool_id}
```
This lets Console compute cost-normalized KPIs.

mike: One caveat: adding histograms at 30s resolution will increase cardinality. We'll sample less frequent for low-traffic pools. Plan: emit histograms for pools with qps > 10, and aggregated `pool_all` rollups for low traffic.

sasha: Good tradeoff. Let's capture the contract and owners as action items.

ava: Action items for Console: 1) make dashboard scaffold using the proposed names and labels, 2) add derived panels for percent_requests_with_wait_lt_50ms and saturation heatmap, 3) fallback to aggregated rollups when per-pool not available.

jamal: Action items runtime: 1) add the three runtime metric names above, 2) add exemplars for p95 for debugging, 3) include tokens metrics. I'll open PR by EOD.

mike: Action items infra: 1) exporter for pool_inflight/capacity/fill_rate/backpressure, 2) sampling policy for histogram emission, 3) ensure remote_write to Cortex w/ 30s scrape. I'll create infra ticket and ping storage team.

leah: SRE action: add Alertmanager rule for saturation_ratio > 0.9 for 2m and backpressure_count > 5 for 1m. I'll draft and put in PR.

infra-bot: new ticket created: INFRA-2157 "pool exporter + batching signals" assigned to mike, due 2026-04-02 :robot_face: 

sasha: Thanks all — if no objections I'll lock the v1 metric contract tomorrow and Ava can start wiring Console panels. Please add any blockers here. :thumbsup:

jamal: LGTM from runtime.

mike: LGTM from infra.

ava: LGTM, will start scaffold.

leah: LGTM — will review Alert PR.

sasha: closing in 24h unless anyone raises issues.
summary: Coord call to assign ownership and contract for continuous-batching and queueing metrics: runtime will emit batch histograms + wait buckets, infra will emit pool inflight/capacity/fill_rate/backpressure, Console will scaffold dashboard and compute derived SLOs. Action items + ticket INFRA-2157 created.
